note: Alberta Parks provincial park about 68 km southeast of Edmonton, with three loops (A, B, C) of spacious sites in mixed forest set back from Miquelon Lake. Playgrounds, an amphitheatre, summer interpretive programs and trails for hiking, mountain biking and skiing. Power pedestals are limited to a total load of 24 amps at 120 volts, and an extension cord is recommended to reach them. --Claude
